title: Wyoming Paycheck Calculator 2026 – Take-Home Pay
metaDescription: Estimate Wyoming take-home pay from federal withholding, Social Security, Medicare and employee deductions. Wyoming has no state wage income tax.
heading: Wyoming Paycheck Calculator

parts.markdown:
Use the Wyoming paycheck calculator to estimate take-home pay from your salary or hourly earnings. Wyoming has no individual state income tax on wages. Federal withholding, Social Security, Medicare and deductions such as insurance or retirement contributions still affect the amount you receive.


## How to Use the Wyoming Paycheck Calculator

Choose the pay schedule shown on your pay stub. Enter annual salary or hourly wages and hours worked, including qualifying overtime where applicable.

Enter the federal income tax withheld for that pay period. Include any extra federal withholding in the total and enter zero if none was withheld. Add your applicable retirement contributions, eligible health premiums and other employee deductions in the Benefits tab. Each deduction should appear once.

If your employer has already paid you wages this year, use the year-to-date Social Security and Medicare taxable wages before the paycheck you are modeling when approaching either threshold.

Read the [Wyoming Department of Revenue](https://revenue.wyo.gov/) for state tax information. [IRS Publication 15](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p15) explains federal payroll contributions. For federal withholding procedures, see [IRS Publication 15-T](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p15t).


## Wyoming Paycheck Example: $65,000 Salary

A $65,000 salary paid biweekly gives $2,500 in gross pay across 26 regular pay periods. This example uses an illustrative $216.15 federal withholding amount, with no benefit deductions or federal wage thresholds reached.

Use your own pay stub to compare results. If you live or work in more than one state, ask payroll about withholding outside Wyoming. The [US paycheck calculator](/calculators/paycheck-calculator/) accepts separate state and local amounts when they apply.


## Comparing Hourly and Salary Offers

Use the [salary-to-hourly calculator](/calculators/salary-to-hourly-calculator/) to compare gross compensation. Then compare the net amounts from the paycheck calculator after accounting for benefits and deductions. On a biweekly schedule, your average monthly income includes the effect of months with an extra paycheck. The [budget calculator](/calculators/budget-calculator/) can help you plan around months with two paychecks.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Does Wyoming withhold state income tax from ordinary wages?

Wyoming has no individual state income tax on ordinary wages. Federal taxes and any eligible employee deductions still apply.

### Why is my net pay lower than my gross pay?

Federal withholding, Social Security, Medicare, and employee benefits are common deductions. Compare the amounts for the same pay period on your pay stub.

### What if I commute to a job outside Wyoming?

Your work state may have different withholding rules. Enter those amounts in the national calculator if they apply, and confirm the state rules with payroll.
